navidi.title: Statistics for Engineers and Scientists
navidi.note: A reference book in the STA 115 course folder (same department).

population-sampling-and-sampling-methods.why: Simple random samples and other sampling ideas.

sampling-distribution-of-the-mean.why: The sampling distribution of the sample mean.

sampling-distribution-of-proportions.why: The normal approximation for sample proportions.

estimation-confidence-intervals-and-samp.read: Sections 4.9 and 5.1 to 5.3 (point estimation; confidence intervals)
estimation-confidence-intervals-and-samp.why: Estimators, intervals for means and proportions, and sample size.

tests-for-means-proportions-and-variance.read: Sections 6.3 and 6.4 (tests for a proportion; small-sample tests for a mean)
tests-for-means-proportions-and-variance.why: z and t tests used in the course.

regression-and-correlation.why: Pearson's r and the fitted line.
